question: ¿Cuántos posibles venteos detectados por satélite desde el 1 de enero de 2024, dentro del contorno de alguna concesión, caen dentro de un área protegida del Instituto Geográfico Nacional?

attempts.query: WITH v AS (SELECT gml_id, lon, lat FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado WHERE fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND lon IS NOT NULL AND lat IS NOT NULL), cpts AS (SELECT c.id_concesion AS pid, p.ord, (p.pt->>0)::float8 AS x, (p.pt->>1)::float8 AS y FROM sig_energia.concesion c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.anillo::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(pt, ord) WHERE c.anillo IS NOT NULL AND c.anillo <> ''), cedges AS (SELECT pid, x AS x1, y AS y1, COALESCE(lead(x) OVER w, first_value(x) OVER w) AS x2, COALESCE(lead(y) OVER w, first_value(y) OVER w) AS y2 FROM cpts WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY ord)), en_conc AS (SELECT DISTINCT gml_id, lon, lat FROM (SELECT v.gml_id, v.lon, v.lat, e.pid FROM v JOIN cedges e ON ((e.y1 > v.lat) <> (e.y2 > v.lat)) AND v.lon < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (v.lat - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1 GROUP BY v.gml_id, v.lon, v.lat, e.pid HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1) s), apts AS (SELECT a.gid || '-' || r.rn AS pid, p.ord, (p.pt->>0)::float8 AS x, (p.pt->>1)::float8 AS y FROM ign.area_protegida a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a.anillos::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(ring, rn) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.ring) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(pt, ord) WHERE a.anillos IS NOT NULL AND a.anillos <> ''), aedges AS (SELECT pid, x AS x1, y AS y1, COALESCE(lead(x) OVER w, first_value(x) OVER w) AS x2, COALESCE(lead(y) OVER w, first_value(y) OVER w) AS y2 FROM apts WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY ord)), en_area AS (SELECT DISTINCT gml_id FROM (SELECT c.gml_id, e.pid FROM en_conc c JOIN aedges e ON ((e.y1 > c.lat) <> (e.y2 > c.lat)) AND c.lon < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (c.lat - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1 GROUP BY c.gml_id, e.pid HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1) s) SELECT count(*) AS venteos FROM en_area
